no_signal_rows.note: No product signal. Kept out of every baseline and lift calculation; these rows are not evidence of promoting the target product.

unclassified.note: unknown feature values are unclassified, not false. They are excluded from layer comparisons.

metric_definitions.snapshot_policy: Use preferred_snapshot per row: fetch_post_detail when a detail payload exists, otherwise fetch_video_search_result. All values are single snapshots captured on 2026-10-30, not lifetime totals. is_estimated is null in every payload; it is not treated as a measured value.

aggregation.why_median: Play and engagement counts are heavy-tailed. The mean is pulled up by a small number of high-reach videos, so the median and quartiles describe the typical video. The overall mean/median ratio is reported for each metric.
aggregation.quartile_method: Python statistics.quantiles(method='exclusive'), equivalent to PERCENTILE.EXC. The F decision IQRs use this method.
aggregation.insufficient_rule: Layers with n<8 report counts only. No median, lift, CI or conclusion is reported for them.
aggregation.unknown_rule: unknown feature values are unclassified, not false. They are excluded from layer comparisons and from lift calculations.
aggregation.overlap_note: A video appears in one layer per dimension. Tables for different dimensions overlap and must not be summed.
aggregation.traceability: Every layer count is computed from the 10 rows in video_level. Each video_level row carries the raw metric values and engagement_source: endpoint, raw file, captured_at, request_id and field_paths. No layer median is computed because no layer reaches n>=8.
aggregation.no_stratified_baseline: No predefined dimension has a layer with n>=8. This round produces no stratified baseline.

bootstrap.reason: No exact layer has both n>=8 and complement n>=8. By rule, n<8 layers receive counts only and no CI. Bootstrap is restricted to the exact population; there is no exact stratified comparison to test.

high_performers.definition: interaction_rate >= 2.0 * median interaction_rate of the 10 exact videos. No duration bucket reaches n>=8, so no duration-bucket peer median is used.
high_performers.statement: 2 条 exact 视频的互动率达到 10 条 exact 中位数的 2 倍。

common_features.note: Only counts are available. n<8, so this is not a comparison and not a conclusion.

low_denominator_sensitivity.note: Descriptive only. The high-performer set is below the 8-video layer floor.

strongest_single_feature.reason: No layer in the 10-row exact population reaches n>=8. No rank, multiple, p-value or CI is computed.
strongest_single_feature.conclusion: 本轮不做分层比较。C16 的否定结论依据是 10 条 exact 无法检验，不能写成已证明没有形态跑赢。

sufficiency_assessment.c16_basis: 10 条 exact 无法做分层检验。结论只能写成样本不足以检验，不能写成已证明没有内容形态跑赢。
sufficiency_assessment.statement: 本轮只给 10 条 exact 的整体分布和逐条明细。没有任何一层同时满足层 n>=8 和对照 n>=8，所以只给计数，不给中位数、CI 或结论。

content_tag_evidence.evidence_snippet: mom cozy belly bands. what do yal think? i want to order one and try it out. i'm in so much pain because of how rapidly my belly is growing. probably gonna be a big b

category_reference.note: Category reference only. Not baseline eligible. Do not merge with the exact baseline. Do not compare medians and do not claim that one content form wins.

evidence_gaps: 10 条 exact 中没有任何一层同时满足层 n>=8 和对照 n>=8。时长档为 <=15s 1 条、16-30s 4 条、31-60s 4 条、>60s 1 条；has_link 和 ad_disclosure 只有一个取值；platform_is_ad 的 false 只有 1 条。分层基线不成立。
comparison 与 demo 在 10 条 exact 中全部 unknown。没有字幕、音轨或视频帧，无法判断画面是否对比或演示。
31 条 medium 只作品类参照。19 条 duplicate_listing_anchor 锚到同品牌 YB001 系列的其他 listing；product_id 不同，标题相似但不相同。12 条 text_brand_and_category 没有商品锚点。
关键词搜索样本不是概率样本。141 条视频中只有 10 条锚点确证目标商品，不能代表品类普查。
所有指标是 2026-10-30 的单次快照。播放和互动会继续增长，快照之间不可直接比较寿命周期表现。
第三方视频的 GMV、成交、转化、受众画像和字幕不可得；本轮不涉及达人受众或达人层级基线。
is_estimated 字段在所有返回中不存在；产物记 null，未当作实测值。
caveats: 中位数和四分位数描述典型视频。均值受长尾影响，表中同时给出 mean/median 比值。
本轮不做分层基线。任何按内容形态的比较都没有样本支撑。
高表现视频只做计数和倍数描述，不做因果解释。10 条 exact 里只有少量高表现，不能代表总体。
category_reference 是品类参照，不是基线。不要把它与 exact 基线合并、比较或用于「哪类跑赢」的结论。
分层表之间会重叠；同一视频出现在多个维度中，不能相加。
